scope: Synthetic CPU contract review; no production training, original test records, production private checkpoints, paid dispatch, GPU, Modal, HF writes, or reviewer commit.
policy: Preserve exact original SHA for small synthetic inputs, scripts, patches, raw logs and JSON metadata. Checkpoint .pt and safetensors weights remain in /tmp and are excluded from ordinary Git archive. Receipts retain their verified original weight digests; archive is not a complete training checkpoint directory.
